statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis codes are G45.9, I34.0, Z86.73
Cardiac event monitoring CPT 93271 is ordered
The service is ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias that may be contributing to embolic events
The service is clinically indicated given the recurrent transient neurological deficits
The claim for CPT 93271 was denied
The denial reason code is PR-204
